m15.text: Vronos orders the villagers' corpses burned after a village killing, but that night wolf-like child werewolves ambush his camp and kill his troops, and he realizes the village children were not innocent.
Swarmed by the werewolves, he finds himself among the Ethersworn vedalken, who value him as a new planeswalker and teach him to planeswalk, repairing his face with an etherium infix and mask.
He returns as a penitent and Avacyn forgives him, and he becomes the Gray Fencer, first of the masked cathars, and Avacyn tasks him with finding the cursed planeswalker Garruk.
Garruk overwhelms and wounds him, and when Garruk finds him later, Vronos bows his head as the axe falls, and Garruk takes his mask as a trophy.
